nodes.description: CRISPR-generated Dnah8 knockout males are sterile with MMAF. ICSI with their sperm gave good pregnancy outcomes.

ICSI bypasses the motility and flagellar defect. A clinical pregnancy was reported for compound heterozygous patients, and a healthy child was born to a splice-variant proband. That proband's partner, however, had recurrent early embryonic arrest across seven ICSI attempts, with only two viable embryos, so a contribution of DNAH8 to early embryo development has been suggested but not established. ICSI with Dnah8 knockout sperm also gave good pregnancy outcomes in mice.
